event.title: docs(specs): remove the specs of the build and check scripts
event.author: gorkma
event.body:
The code folders are now `mcp`, `scripts/render`, `scripts/runtime` and `src` only (`code-paths.chosen.json`). Predictable no longer analyses the build and check scripts in `scripts/` or the helpers in `scripts/lib`, so their specs are leftovers that nothing verifies.

## Changes

- Delete 9 specs:
  - `specs/scripts/build-mcp-firebase.ts.spec.md`
  - `specs/scripts/build-mcp-metadata.ts.spec.md`
  - `specs/scripts/build-pieces.mjs.spec.md`
  - `specs/scripts/check-islands.mjs.spec.md`
  - `specs/scripts/check-pieces.mjs.spec.md`
  - `specs/scripts/check-runtime.mjs.spec.md`
  - `specs/scripts/lib/pieces-harness.mjs.spec.md`
  - `specs/scripts/lib/preact-alias.mjs.spec.md`
  - `specs/scripts/lib/tag-contract.mjs.spec.md`
- In `specs/_areas.md`, delete the "Piece Checks" area. No spec uses it now.

The "Build Scripts" area stays: `specs/mcp/tools/list-components.ts.spec.md` still uses it.

Three of the deleted specs had inferred requirements (build-pieces 6, check-runtime 2, tag-contract 1). They are deleted on purpose.

No file outside `specs/` refers to the deleted specs. No file under `scripts/`, no test, and no spec under `specs/src`, `specs/mcp`, `specs/scripts/render` or `specs/scripts/runtime` changes.
